t: You are looking at the Monument for the Millennium, a tall monumental column in the City of London. It was designed by Ptolemy Dean, an architect who is the Surveyor of the Fabric of Westminster Abbey and who specialises in historic preservation. He is also known from the BBC series Restoration and The Perfect Village. The sculpture is by Nicola Hicks, an English sculptor known for working in straw and plaster. The column marks the year 2000 in the heart of the old city.
